read.thesis: Record Q3 with $205B net inflows, 11% organic base fee growth and 47.8% operating margin; supply-side lens is limited since this is an asset manager, with the AI-financing and private-markets pipeline the key growth claim.

triggers.label: Organic base fee growth 11%
triggers.quote: Organic base fee growth of 11% marks our ninth consecutive quarter at or above 5%.

triggers.label: Effective fee rate flat QoQ
triggers.quote: On an equivalent day count basis, our annualized effective fee rate was approximately flat compared to the second quarter.

triggers.label: Evergreen private markets turning
triggers.quote: We still have redemptions in the queue.

triggers.label: Meta $14B Texas data-centre financing
triggers.quote: We partnered with Meta on the financing of its planned $14 billion data center in Texas

guidance.quote: we anticipate repurchasing at least $550 million worth of shares in the fourth quarter
we continue to expect a mid-single-digit percentage increase in full-year G&A
We continue to estimate that 25% is a reasonable projected tax run rate for the fourth quarter of 2026.
We remain committed to low- to mid-teens ACV growth over the long term.

prior_guidance_check.quote: In the third quarter, we repurchased $550 million worth of shares.
